SELECT
    TRY_CAST(transaction_id AS VARCHAR)         AS transaction_id,
    TRY_CAST(transaction_date AS VARCHAR)       AS transaction_date,
    TRY_CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR)               AS store_id,
    TRY_CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR)             AS product_id,
    TRY_CAST(product_name AS VARCHAR)           AS product_name,
    TRY_CAST(category AS VARCHAR)               AS category,
    TRY_CAST(quantity AS INTEGER)               AS quantity,
    TRY_CAST(unit_price AS DOUBLE)              AS unit_price,
    TRY_CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE)            AS total_amount,
    TRY_CAST(customer_segment AS VARCHAR)       AS customer_segment,
    TRY_CAST(payment_method AS VARCHAR)         AS payment_method
FROM read_csv_auto('raw_files/sales_data.csv', all_varchar=true);

SELECT
    TRY_CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR)        AS product_id,
    TRY_CAST(product_name AS VARCHAR)      AS product_name,
    TRY_CAST(category AS VARCHAR)          AS category,
    TRY_CAST(standard_price AS DOUBLE)     AS standard_price
FROM read_csv_auto('raw_files/products.csv', all_varchar=true) AS t;

SELECT
    TRY_CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR)      AS store_id,
    TRY_CAST(store_name AS VARCHAR)    AS store_name,
    TRY_CAST(region AS VARCHAR)        AS region,
    TRY_CAST(city AS VARCHAR)          AS city,
    TRY_CAST(state AS VARCHAR)         AS state
FROM read_csv_auto('raw_files/stores.csv', all_varchar=true);

WITH medians AS (
    SELECT
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY quantity)    AS median_quantity,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY unit_price) AS median_unit_price,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_amount) AS median_total_amount
    FROM sales_data_bronze_d7ebdfba
    WHERE quantity IS NOT NULL
      AND unit_price IS NOT NULL
      AND total_amount IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    -- transaction_date: standardize_date
    COALESCE(
        TRY_STRPTIME(transaction_date, '%Y-%m-%d'),
        TRY_STRPTIME(transaction_date, '%m/%d/%Y')
    )::VARCHAR AS transaction_date,

    -- store_id: null_handler drop_nulls (already filtered in WHERE)
    store_id,

    -- product_id: null_handler drop_nulls (already filtered in WHERE)
    product_id,

    -- product_name: fill_unknown
    COALESCE(product_name, 'Unknown') AS product_name,

    -- category: normalize_category
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'elec%'               THEN 'Electronics'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'apparel%' 
             OR LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'cloth%'           THEN 'Apparel'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'beauty%' 
             OR LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'cosmetic%'       THEN 'Beauty'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'sport%'              THEN 'Sports'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'home%' 
             OR LOWER(TRIM(category)) LIKE 'kitchen%'        THEN 'Home & Kitchen'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS category,

    -- quantity: fill_median
    COALESCE(quantity, (SELECT median_quantity FROM medians)) AS quantity,

    -- unit_price: fill_median
    COALESCE(unit_price, (SELECT median_unit_price FROM medians)) AS unit_price,

    -- total_amount: fill_median
    COALESCE(total_amount, (SELECT median_total_amount FROM medians)) AS total_amount,

    -- customer_segment: normalize_segment
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(customer_segment)) LIKE 'prem%'        THEN 'Premium'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(customer_segment)) LIKE 'bgt%' 
             OR LOWER(TRIM(customer_segment)) LIKE 'budg%'    THEN 'Budget'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(customer_segment)) LIKE 'stand%' 
             OR LOWER(TRIM(customer_segment)) LIKE 'std%'     THEN 'Standard'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(customer_segment)) LIKE 'loyal%'       THEN 'Loyal'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS customer_segment,

    -- payment_method: fill_unknown
    COALESCE(payment_method, 'Unknown') AS payment_method,

    -- _load_timestamp: null_handler drop_nulls (already filtered in WHERE)
    _load_timestamp,

    -- _source_file: null_handler drop_nulls (already filtered in WHERE)
    _source_file

FROM sales_data_bronze_d7ebdfba
WHERE store_id IS NOT NULL
  AND product_id IS NOT NULL
  AND _load_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND _source_file IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT
    product_name,
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(category) LIKE 'elec%' THEN 'Electronics'
        WHEN LOWER(category) LIKE 'apparel%' OR LOWER(category) LIKE 'cloth%' THEN 'Apparel'
        WHEN LOWER(category) LIKE 'beauty%' OR LOWER(category) LIKE 'cosmetic%' THEN 'Beauty'
        WHEN LOWER(category) LIKE 'sport%' THEN 'Sports'
        WHEN LOWER(category) LIKE 'home%' OR LOWER(category) LIKE 'kitchen%' THEN 'Home & Kitchen'
        ELSE category
    END AS category,
    COALESCE(
        standard_price,
        (SELECT median(standard_price) FROM products_bronze_d7ebdfba)
    ) AS standard_price,
    _load_timestamp,
    _source_file
FROM products_bronze_d7ebdfba
WHERE _load_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND _source_file IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(store_name, 'UNKNOWN') AS store_name,
    LOWER(TRIM(region)) AS region,
    COALESCE(city, 'UNKNOWN') AS city,
    COALESCE(state, 'UNKNOWN') AS state,
    _load_timestamp,
    _source_file
FROM stores_bronze_d7ebdfba
WHERE _load_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND _source_file IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    s.product_name,
    SUM(s.total_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM
    sales_data_silver_d7ebdfba AS s
LEFT JOIN
    products_silver_d7ebdfba AS p
    ON s.product_name = p.product_name
WHERE
    CAST(s.transaction_date AS DATE) >= (
        SELECT MAX(CAST(transaction_date AS DATE))
        FROM sales_data_silver_d7ebdfba
    ) - INTERVAL '12' MONTH
GROUP BY
    s.product_name
ORDER BY
    total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
